title: elytrigia tauri subsp. pertenuis
intro: Elytrigia tauri subsp. pertenuis, commonly known as  Elymus pungens, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family, Poaceae. It is native to Europe and Asia, and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce swelling and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Elytrigia tauri subsp. pertenuis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating effects.
